_note: Phase 11 rough / similarity query set (hand-authored, extend freely). 30 base configs: 10 generic 1-sentence, 10 specific 1-sentence, 10 specific 2-3-sentence. Each carries INTUITION sliders (soft only: tones curve + prose word + dialogue float) so the SAME 30 run twice -- semantic-only vs + sliders = 60 configs, an A/B. Slider WORDS come from the tag tables (utils.tags Tone/Intensity/ProseRegister) and convert through query.tone_curve / query.prose_level -- NEVER hand-type coordinates. `tones` = ordered [tone_word, intensity_word] beats. pov/tense are left unset on purpose (hard filters EXCLUDE; the goal is similar scenes, not a narrowed set).

rough_queries.summary: A tense confrontation between two characters.
A quiet moment of grief after a loss.
A joyful reunion between long-separated friends.
A dangerous journey through a hostile wilderness.
A moment of sudden betrayal.
A tender romantic encounter.
A chaotic battle.
A character wrestles with a fateful decision.
An eerie, foreboding atmosphere before something goes wrong.
A triumphant victory won against the odds.
A soldier returns home from war to find everything he knew has changed.
A thief creeps through a sleeping mansion at night to steal a jewel.
A doomed lover pleads at a deathbed as the beloved slips away.
A captain rallies his terrified crew as the ship founders in a storm.
A prisoner quietly plots an escape from a locked cell.
A child discovers a hidden door and steps into a strange new world.
Two rivals meet for a duel of honor at dawn.
A jury returns and a verdict is delivered in a crowded courtroom.
A hunter stalks dangerous prey through a forest until it turns on him.
A monarch is betrayed by a trusted advisor in the throne room.
A weary traveler arrives at an inn during a snowstorm. A stranger by the fire offers an ominous warning, and the traveler slowly realizes he is being hunted.
Two estranged brothers meet years after a bitter falling-out. Old wounds reopen as they argue, but by the end a fragile reconciliation begins.
A young woman defies her family to marry for love. Her father forbids the match, and she flees into the night with her lover.
During a plague, a doctor works desperately to save a dying village. He loses patient after patient, and at last succumbs to despair.
A shipwrecked sailor washes ashore on a deserted island. Alone and starving, he searches for water and slowly loses hope of rescue.
An old king divides his kingdom among his heirs. Flattery wins over honesty, and he banishes the one child who truly loves him.
A detective confronts the murderer in a locked drawing room. Laying out the evidence piece by piece, he watches the killer's composure finally crack.
A soldier in the trenches waits for the order to advance. When the whistle blows he charges across open ground into the guns.
A grieving widow visits her husband's grave each morning. One day she finds a stranger there who knew him, and learns a secret that reshapes her memory.
A revolution erupts in the city square. The crowd storms the palace gates, and a young idealist raises the banner as the guards open fire.
